review_text: The food was really good as well as their Matcha. We ordered their Shrimp Truffle pasta which was really creamy. Also their Kare-Kare, which was really tender and seasoned well. I like the ambiance between coffee shop and little dinner.

this is an honest review from me i really like the service, the staff were very accommodating but the food took too long to be served and the ambiance of the cafe was simple and quite, but but the food that we ordered was not good. we ordered the spicy pork cutlet, fries, honey glazed chicken, and the carbonara. the honey glazed chicken was delicious we liked it but the spicy pork cutlet was not a cutlet at all, it doesn't looks like a cutlet and doesn't taste like a pork cutlet. And for the fries i get that they want to achieve the self made fries or whatever you call it that you make the fries personally, but it doesn't justify that you serve it overcooked but not crispy, but on the otherhand i like the sauce. i really thought the food they serve was good and was worth the hype but i was wrong, i did not expect our experience would be like this.

A Cafe near a public Hospital in a busy area of Toril District in Davao City. Place is cozy and food is good..The rice meal and Pasta were good coffee is good too. For someone who loves coffee this place i a must to visit in Toril..the area is near a convenience store where you can buy necessities and eat. They also offer take out so you can enjoy their food in the comfort of your home. Staffs are approachable and good. They have also offer cakes and pastries. All their foods were well prepared that you can enjoy while having some chit chat with a friend. I love the ambience of the Cafe to rate this would 10/10 for their food and services.

good food with a nice ambience, definitely a place you have to visit! my favorites are their herbed fillet and monte cristo sandwich. it's a bit far from downtown but it's so worth it. sincerely enjoyed my time here. 💗 see photos for some of the food snaps i had when i visited.

If you're searching for a not-so-crowded coffee shop to work or study in, this is it! milk teas, frappes, hot and cold coffee, and pastries at reasonable prices. They also provide a menu for bf and lunch. I didn't snap a photo of my food and drink because I order takeaway. This cafe deserves a 5 ⭐.
